UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Store owner profile and app reminder preferences.

storeName.description: Name of the sari-sari store or small business.

reminderTemplate.description: Template used for payment reminder messages.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

Customer.title: Customer
Customer.description: A store customer with a running utang balance.

phone.description: Optional phone number for SMS reminders.

creditLimitCentavos.description: Optional credit limit in Philippine centavos.

balanceCentavos.description: Denormalized running balance in Philippine centavos.

lastPaymentAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent payment transaction.

lastActivityAt.description: Server timestamp of the most recent activity (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the customer was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the customer was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

UtangTransaction.title: UtangTransaction
UtangTransaction.description: A single credit (CREDIT) or payment (PAYMENT) entry for a customer.

type.description: Whether the customer took items on credit or made a payment.

amountCentavos.description: Positive transaction amount in Philippine centavos.

description.description: Optional description of items or payment.

date.description: Transaction date chosen by the store owner.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the transaction was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the transaction was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: Store profile and reminder settings owned by userId.

/users/{userId}/customers/{customerId}.description: Customers belonging to the store owner userId.

/users/{userId}/customers/{customerId}/t.description: Credit and payment transactions for a specific customer.
